from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentMatchFact(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single legal document needed to match it to a judgment result."""
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., Judgment, Ruling)")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case number referenced in the text")
    court: str | None = Field(description="The court name or location where the case was heard")
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of the key parties involved (appellant, appellee, applicant, etc.)")
    ruling_outcome: str | None = Field(description="The main decision text describing the court's ruling")
    fee_details: list[str] = Field(description="Text snippets describing fees, amounts, and who bears them")
    key_amounts: list[str] = Field(description="Specific monetary values or asset values mentioned in the judgment")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the core facts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentMatchFact]
